Name: Withdraw funds
Description: Positive: POST /api/accounts/{id}/withdraw returns 200 OK amount debited from balance

Name: Get account not exist
Description: Negative: GET /api/accounts/{id} returns 404 if account not exist

Name: Create new account
Description: Positive: POST /api/accounts creates account and returns 201

Name: Deposit funds
Description: Positive: POST /api/accounts/{id}/deposit returns 200 OK amount added to balance

Name: Transfer between accounts
Description: Positive: POST /api/accounts/{fromId}/transfer returns 200 OK amount transferred between accounts
